text:
Sam: Hey \u2014 quick food check: there\u2019s a new Filipino spot "Manila Munch" by Jack London that just opened. Thinking of a 12:30 group order after standup. Anyone in? menu: https://manila-munch.example/menu
Tova: Ooh nice! Is it ~5\u20137min walk from the office?
Marcus: I can do 12:30 and pick up if folks want a group run.
Anika: I\u2019m gluten-free \u2014 do they have gf options?
Sophia: I can drive and take 3 ppl. Need a seat? @Anika @Marcus
Marcus: @Anika I glanced at the menu \u2014 they list "rice wraps" as GF option and a tofu adobo that looks safe.
Tova: I\u2019ll double-check w/ the restaurant, but their online menu shows veggie pancit and a tofu adobo. :bento_box:
Sam: sweet. If Marcus is picking up, can everyone post what they want in thread so I can consolidate? I'll Venmo and cover insulated bags.
Marcus: Order so far:
```
1x Veggie Pancit
2x Tofu Adobo
1x Garlic Rice
```
Anika: I\u2019ll take 1x Rice Wrap w/ pork adobo (GF) and a side salad.
Sophia: I\u2019ll take 2x lumpia (veg) and 1x sisig (small).
Tova: I\u2019ll probably just grab a small pancit and water.
Sam: Heads up \u2014 I'll be 3min late from standup, leave room for one more item. :clock3:
DevExBot: Quick FYI: Lunch pickup etiquette reminder \u2014 label your containers with initials and avoid strong-smelling foods in meeting rooms. :memo:
Marcus: Cool. Planning to leave at 12:20 to get there by 12:30. Any objections?
Anika: No objections. Thanks Marcus!
Sophia: Thanks Sam for organizing. :thumbsup:
Tova: See y'all in 20.
Sam: Thanks all \u2014 I'll post final order and Venmo totals in 10.
